criteria.requirement: Implement ftfy.structured.fix_fields(value,paths,config=None,*,missing="raise"), read_path and normalize_paths. Paths are explicit tuples/lists of string dict keys and nonnegative integer list indices, never dotted-string guesses; support empty root path and stable deduplication. Repair only selected text through actual fix_text, retain None and all nonselected data/keys. Return deep-copied result and leave original unchanged on any late failure. Missing keys/indices may raise or skip, type mismatches/nontext leaves always fail. Preserve caller config and original container structures.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
